apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.39.4 - A FELLOWSHIP'S LIST ON THE PHONE (and Website Update 94)
  - On the phone of the one who takes a fellowship's attendance, the list shows only the members of that ministry (Men's
    fellowship → those with Men in their Ministry; Setup → the meeting → "For the members of" when the names differ), and
    anyone already ticked. "+ Someone else who came" shows the whole list. Bible study and the prayer meeting list everyone.
    Adding a visitor stays the same.
